\section[a pobreza]{a pobreza — the poverty}

\label{lesson:PT-C366-pobreza}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the prejudice, then the Portuguese for the stereotype.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a pobreza}
\textbf{a pobreza} — \textquotedblleft{}the poverty\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
A pobreza diminuiu nos últimos anos.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Poverty has gone down in recent years.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Viver na pobreza} — to live in poverty.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{pobreza} is inherited from Old Portuguese \emph{pobreza} (EtymDB), built on \emph{pobre} \textquotedblleft{}poor\textquotedblright{}, from Latin \emph{pauper} \textquotedblleft{}poor\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short), with the suffix \emph{-eza}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a pobreza}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a pobreza}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{a pobreza}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Portuguese for the prejudice, then the Portuguese for the stereotype, then say \emph{a pobreza} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does a pobreza mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The poverty\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[a discriminação]{a discriminação — the discrimination}

\label{lesson:PT-C366-discriminacao}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the stereotype, then the Portuguese for the poverty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a discriminação}
\textbf{a discriminação} — \textquotedblleft{}the discrimination\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
A lei proíbe a discriminação no trabalho.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{The law forbids discrimination at work.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Discriminação contra as mulheres} — discrimination against women.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{discriminação} is a learned borrowing from Late Latin \emph{discrīminātiō}, a term of rhetoric for \textquotedblleft{}the contrasting of opposite thoughts\textquotedblright{}, on \emph{discrīmināre} \textquotedblleft{}to divide, to separate\textquotedblright{}, built on \emph{discrīmen} \textquotedblleft{}that which separates or divides\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a discriminação}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a discriminação}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{a discriminação}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Portuguese for the stereotype, then the Portuguese for the poverty, then say \emph{a discriminação} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does a discriminação mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The discrimination\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[discriminar]{discriminar — to discriminate (against)}

\label{lesson:PT-C366-discriminar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the poverty, then the Portuguese for the discrimination.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: discriminar}
\textbf{discriminar} — \textquotedblleft{}to discriminate (against)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Ninguém deve ser discriminado pela cor da pele.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Nobody should be discriminated against for the colour of their skin.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Discriminar alguém} — to discriminate against someone.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{discriminar} is a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{discrīmināre} \textquotedblleft{}to divide, to separate\textquotedblright{}, built on \emph{discrīmen} \textquotedblleft{}that which divides two things\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[a imigração]{a imigração — the immigration}

\label{lesson:PT-C366-imigracao}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the discrimination, then the Portuguese for to discriminate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a imigração}
\textbf{a imigração} — \textquotedblleft{}the immigration\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
A imigração mudou muito as cidades.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Immigration has changed the cities a lot.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Imigrante} — immigrant; \emph{a emigração} — emigration, very common in Portuguese history.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{imigração} is built on \emph{imigrar} \textquotedblleft{}to immigrate\textquotedblright{}, a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{immigrāre} \textquotedblleft{}to remove or go into\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short), from \emph{in} and \emph{migrāre} \textquotedblleft{}to move\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[a integração]{a integração — the integration}

\label{lesson:PT-C366-integracao}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a integração}
\textbf{a integração} — \textquotedblleft{}the integration\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
A língua ajuda muito na integração.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{The language helps a lot with integration.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Integrar-se} — to fit in.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{integração} is a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{integrātiō} \textquotedblleft{}a renewing, a restoring\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB, Lewis \& Short), from \emph{integrāre} \textquotedblleft{}to make whole\textquotedblright{}, on \emph{integer} \textquotedblleft{}whole, untouched\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[(dialogue)]{Revisão dos capítulos 359–366}

\label{lesson:PT-R366-revisao-359-366}



\begin{quote}
Say the Portuguese for the manager and the department.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the manager, the department, the task, the staff member, to delegate
  \item the promotion, to promote, the post, the rise, the qualification
  \item stressed, worn out, the overtime, efficient, the productivity
  \item the salary, the allowance, to negotiate, the retirement, retired
  \item the citizen, the citizenship, the right, the freedom, the equality
  \item to protest, the protest, the demonstration, to show, to demand
  \item the justice, unfair, the injustice, the prejudice, the stereotype
  \item the poverty, the discrimination, to discriminate, the immigration, the integration
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The manager? (\textbf{o gerente}.) The department? (\textbf{o departamento}.) The task? (\textbf{a tarefa}.) The staff member? (\textbf{o colaborador}.) To delegate? (\textbf{delegar}.) The promotion? (\textbf{a promoção}.) To promote? (\textbf{promover}.) The post? (\textbf{o cargo}.) The rise? (\textbf{o aumento}.) The qualification? (\textbf{a qualificação}.) Stressed? (\textbf{stressado}.) Worn out? (\textbf{esgotado}.) The overtime? (\textbf{as horas extraordinárias}.) Efficient? (\textbf{eficiente}.) The productivity? (\textbf{a produtividade}.) The salary? (\textbf{o ordenado}.) The allowance? (\textbf{o subsídio}.) To negotiate? (\textbf{negociar}.) The retirement? (\textbf{a reforma}.) Retired? (\textbf{reformado}.) The citizen? (\textbf{o cidadão}.) The citizenship? (\textbf{a cidadania}.) The right? (\textbf{o direito}.) The freedom? (\textbf{a liberdade}.) The equality? (\textbf{a igualdade}.) To protest? (\textbf{protestar}.) The protest? (\textbf{o protesto}.) The demonstration? (\textbf{a manifestação}.) To show? (\textbf{manifestar}.) To demand? (\textbf{exigir}.) The justice? (\textbf{a justiça}.) Unfair? (\textbf{injusto}.) The injustice? (\textbf{a injustiça}.) The prejudice? (\textbf{o preconceito}.) The stereotype? (\textbf{o estereótipo}.) The poverty? (\textbf{a pobreza}.) The discrimination? (\textbf{a discriminação}.) To discriminate? (\textbf{discriminar}.) The immigration? (\textbf{a imigração}.) The integration? (\textbf{a integração}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
